name: Kotlin
exports_detected: Top-level fun / class / object / interface / typealias / val / var
data class / sealed class / enum class / annotation class
description: 🟪 Everything public by default — skips private, internal, and protected. Companion objects stay out.

detection_rules.title: Public by default
detection_rules.description: Kotlin's visibility default is public. Any top-level declaration without private/internal/protected is captured.

detection_rules.title: Visibility exclusions
detection_rules.description: Lines starting with private, internal, or protected are skipped regardless of the declaration type.
detection_rules.example_code:
private fun internalHelper() {}   // excluded
internal fun packageHelper() {}   // excluded
protected fun subclassHelper() {} // excluded
public fun explicitPublic() {}    // included

detection_rules.title: Data, sealed, enum, annotation classes
detection_rules.description: All class variants are captured. The class name is extracted regardless of modifier prefix.

detection_rules.title: Suspend and inline functions
detection_rules.description: Coroutine and inline functions are captured under their function name.

## Purpose

Kotlin auth service for the Android/JVM platform.

## Public API

| Symbol | Kind | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `createAuth` | fun | Creates an Auth instance |
| `AuthService` | class | Auth service class |
| `AuthState` | sealed class | Auth state union type |
| `DEFAULT_TTL` | val | Default TTL constant |

## Change Log

| Date | Change |
|------|--------|
| 2026-01-01 | Initial |
caveats: Companion objects (companion object { ... }) are skipped as standalone exports.
Extension functions are captured if they are top-level and public.
Operator overloads (operator fun ...) are included under their function name.
